description: This file defines UI components and formatting logic for displaying node information in a menu within a SwiftUI and AppKit-based macOS application. It includes structures for formatting node entries, rendering node menu rows, and custom icons, focusing on presenting node details like platform, connection status, version, and identity.

classes.name: NodeMenuEntryFormatter
classes.description: Provides static methods for formatting and displaying information about nodes, including platform, version, status, and icons.

classes.name: NodeMenuRowView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a row in the nodes menu, displaying node details with icons and text.

classes.name: AndroidMark
classes.description: A custom SwiftUI view that displays an icon indicating Android devices.

methods.name: isGateway
methods.description: Checks if a NodeInfo entry corresponds to a gateway node.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a NodeInfo entry is currently connected.

methods.name: primaryName
methods.description: Returns the primary display name for a node, prioritizing displayName or defaulting to 'Gateway' or nodeId.

methods.name: summaryText
methods.description: Generates a summary string for a node, including name, role, IP, platform, version, and status.

methods.name: roleText
methods.description: Returns the connection role status of a node.

methods.name: detailLeft
methods.description: Provides a short detail string on the left side, such as IP and role.

methods.name: headlineRight
methods.description: Returns additional platform information for display on the right side of the header.

methods.name: detailRightVersion
methods.description: Returns version labels for display on the right side.

methods.name: platformText
methods.description: Determines the platform label for a node based on its platform or device family.

methods.name: compactVersion
methods.description: Trims whitespace and version suffixes from a version string.

methods.name: shortVersionLabel
methods.description: Returns a shortened version of a version string, prefixing with 'v' if needed.

methods.name: versionLabels
methods.description: Generates core and UI version labels for display.

methods.name: resolveVersions
methods.description: Resolves core and UI versions, falling back to legacy version if necessary.

methods.name: isHeadlessPlatform
methods.description: Checks if the platform is considered headless (darwin, linux, windows).

methods.name: leadingSymbol
methods.description: Returns an appropriate system symbol for the node based on device or platform.

methods.name: isAndroid
methods.description: Checks if a node is identified as an Android device.

methods.name: safeSystemSymbol
methods.description: Checks if a system symbol exists in SF Symbols; falls back if not.
